<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<title>Grammar Portfolio · Chapters 11–20</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Fraunces:opsz,wght@9..144,400;9..144,600;9..144,800&family=Nunito:wght@400;600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
:root{
  --paper:#FBF8FF;
  --card:#FFFFFF;
  --ink:#3F3355;
  --ink-soft:#6E6188;
  --line:#E8DFF6;
  --lav:#E3D7FA;
  --mint:#C9EBDB;
  --peach:#FFD8C6;
  --butter:#FBEEBB;
  --sky:#CFE2FB;
  --rose:#FAD4E4;
  --accent:#8A6BC9;
  --accent-ink:#5B3FA0;
  --shadow:0 2px 0 var(--line);
}
@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark){
  :root:not([data-theme="light"]){
    --paper:#221D2E; --card:#2B2439; --ink:#F2ECFB; --ink-soft:#BCAEDA;
    --line:#3D3352; --accent:#C3A9F5; --accent-ink:#D9C6FF;
    --lav:#4A3A6B; --mint:#2F5548; --peach:#6A4438; --butter:#5E5330; --sky:#31486B; --rose:#5E3550;
  }
}
:root[data-theme="dark"]{
  --paper:#221D2E; --card:#2B2439; --ink:#F2ECFB; --ink-soft:#BCAEDA;
  --line:#3D3352; --accent:#C3A9F5; --accent-ink:#D9C6FF;
  --lav:#4A3A6B; --mint:#2F5548; --peach:#6A4438; --butter:#5E5330; --sky:#31486B; --rose:#5E3550;
}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{
  margin:0; background:var(--paper); color:var(--ink);
  font-family:"Nunito", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;
  font-size:17px; line-height:1.65;
  background-image:
    radial-gradient(circle at 12% 8%, rgba(227,215,250,.55) 0, transparent 34%),
    radial-gradient(circle at 88% 4%, rgba(255,216,198,.45) 0, transparent 30%),
    radial-gradient(circle at 78% 92%, rgba(201,235,219,.45) 0, transparent 32%);
  background-attachment:fixed;
}
h1,h2,h3,h4{font-family:"Fraunces", Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif; font-weight:600; line-height:1.15; margin:0 0 .4em}
h1{font-size:clamp(2.1rem,6vw,3.4rem); font-weight:800; letter-spacing:-.02em}
h2{font-size:clamp(1.5rem,3.6vw,2.1rem)}
h3{font-size:1.18rem}
p{margin:0 0 1em; max-width:68ch}
a{color:var(--accent-ink)}
a:focus-visible,button:focus-visible,[contenteditable]:focus-visible,input:focus-visible,select:focus-visible,textarea:focus-visible{
  outline:3px solid var(--accent); outline-offset:2px; border-radius:6px;
}

/* ---------- layout ---------- */
.wrap{max-width:1040px; margin:0 auto; padding:0 20px 90px}
header.top{
  position:sticky; top:0; z-index:40; backdrop-filter:blur(10px);
  background:color-mix(in srgb, var(--paper) 88%, transparent);
  border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);
}
.topbar{max-width:1040px; margin:0 auto; padding:10px 20px; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:14px}
.brand{font-family:"Fraunces",serif; font-weight:800; font-size:1.05rem; white-space:nowrap}
.brand small{display:block; font-family:"Nunito",sans-serif; font-weight:600; font-size:.7rem; color:var(--ink-soft)}
nav.tabs{display:flex; gap:6px; overflow-x:auto; padding:4px 0; margin-left:auto; scrollbar-width:thin}
nav.tabs button{
  border:1px solid var(--line); background:var(--card); color:var(--ink-soft);
  font-family:inherit; font-size:.82rem; font-weight:700; padding:7px 13px;
  border-radius:999px; cursor:pointer; white-space:nowrap; transition:background .15s,color .15s;
}
nav.tabs button:hover{background:var(--lav); color:var(--ink)}
nav.tabs button[aria-current="page"]{background:var(--accent); border-color:var(--accent); color:#fff}
:root[data-theme="dark"] nav.tabs button[aria-current="page"]{color:#221D2E}
@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark){:root:not([data-theme="light"]) nav.tabs button[aria-current="page"]{color:#221D2E}}
.theme-btn{border:1px solid var(--line); background:var(--card); border-radius:999px; width:36px; height:36px; cursor:pointer; font-size:1rem; flex:none}

section.page{display:none; padding-top:34px; animation:in .28s ease}
section.page.active{display:block}
@keyframes in{from{opacity:0; transform:translateY(6px)} to{opacity:1; transform:none}}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*{animation:none !important; transition:none !important; scroll-behavior:auto}}

.eyebrow{font-size:.78rem; font-weight:700; color:var(--ink-soft); margin:0 0 .35em; letter-spacing:.04em}
.lead{font-size:1.05rem; color:var(--ink-soft); max-width:62ch}

/* ---------- cover ---------- */
.cover{
  border:2px solid var(--line); border-radius:28px; background:var(--card);
  padding:clamp(26px,5vw,52px); position:relative; overflow:hidden;
}
.cover:before{
  content:""; position:absolute; inset:auto -60px -90px auto; width:260px; height:260px; border-radius:50%;
  background:var(--butter); opacity:.5; right:-60px;
}
.cover:after{
  content:""; position:absolute; left:-70px; top:-70px; width:200px; height:200px; border-radius:50%;
  background:var(--mint); opacity:.5;
}
.cover > *{position:relative; z-index:1}
.chips{display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:8px; margin:22px 0 0}
.chip{background:var(--lav); border-radius:999px; padding:6px 13px; font-size:.8rem; font-weight:700}
.chip.m{background:var(--mint)} .chip.p{background:var(--peach)} .chip.b{background:var(--butter)} .chip.s{background:var(--sky)} .chip.r{background:var(--rose)}
.namefield{
  display:inline-block; min-width:220px; border-bottom:2.5px dashed var(--accent);
  font-family:"Fraunces",serif; font-size:1.3rem; padding:2px 8px;
}
[contenteditable]{cursor:text}
[contenteditable]:empty:before{content:attr(data-ph); color:var(--ink-soft); opacity:.65}

.index-grid{display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(230px,1fr)); gap:16px; margin-top:28px}
.index-card{
  text-align:left; border:2px solid var(--line); border-radius:20px; background:var(--card);
  padding:18px; cursor:pointer; font:inherit; color:inherit; transition:border-color .15s, transform .15s;
}
.index-card:hover{border-color:var(--accent); transform:translateY(-3px)}
.index-card .num{font-family:"Fraunces",serif; font-size:2rem; font-weight:800; color:var(--accent); line-height:1}
.index-card h3{margin:.25em 0 .2em}
.index-card p{font-size:.88rem; color:var(--ink-soft); margin:0}

/* ---------- generic cards ---------- */
.card{background:var(--card); border:2px solid var(--line); border-radius:22px; padding:22px; margin:0 0 18px}
.toolbar{display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:10px; align-items:center; margin:0 0 20px}
.btn{
  border:2px solid var(--accent); background:var(--accent); color:#fff; font:inherit; font-weight:700;
  padding:9px 16px; border-radius:999px; cursor:pointer; font-size:.88rem;
}
:root[data-theme="dark"] .btn{color:#221D2E}
@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark){:root:not([data-theme="light"]) .btn{color:#221D2E}}
.btn.ghost{background:var(--card); color:var(--accent-ink)}
.btn.soft{background:var(--lav); border-color:var(--lav); color:var(--ink)}
input[type=text], input[type=search], input[type=url], select, textarea{
  font:inherit; color:var(--ink); background:var(--card); border:2px solid var(--line);
  border-radius:12px; padding:9px 13px; max-width:100%;
}
textarea{width:100%; line-height:1.7; resize:vertical}

/* ---------- grammar guide ---------- */
.guide-grid{display:grid; gap:16px}
.gcard{border:2px solid var(--line); border-radius:22px; background:var(--card); overflow:hidden}
.gcard > summary{
  list-style:none; cursor:pointer; padding:16px 20px; display:flex; gap:14px; align-items:center;
}
.gcard > summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}
.gcard[open] > summary{border-bottom:2px solid var(--line)}
.icon{
  width:50px; height:50px; flex:none; border-radius:16px; display:grid; place-items:center; font-size:1.5rem;
}
.gcard h3{margin:0; font-size:1.05rem}
.gcard .ch{font-size:.76rem; font-weight:700; color:var(--ink-soft)}
.gbody{padding:18px 20px 22px}
.gbody h4{font-size:.83rem; font-weight:700; font-family:"Nunito",sans-serif; color:var(--ink-soft); margin:18px 0 8px}
.gbody h4:first-child{margin-top:0}
.ex{margin:0; padding:0; list-style:none; counter-reset:e}
.ex li{counter-increment:e; padding:9px 0 9px 34px; position:relative; border-bottom:1px dashed var(--line)}
.ex li:last-child{border-bottom:0}
.ex li:before{
  content:counter(e); position:absolute; left:0; top:9px; width:22px; height:22px; border-radius:50%;
  background:var(--lav); display:grid; place-items:center; font-size:.75rem; font-weight:700;
}
.hl{background:var(--butter); border-radius:5px; padding:1px 4px; box-decoration-break:clone; -webkit-box-decoration-break:clone}
.meme{
  margin-top:18px; border:2px dashed var(--line); border-radius:16px; padding:14px 16px;
  display:flex; gap:12px; align-items:flex-start; background:color-mix(in srgb, var(--card) 70%, var(--paper));
}
.meme .face{font-size:1.9rem; line-height:1}
.meme p{margin:0; font-size:.92rem}
.meme strong{display:block; font-family:"Fraunces",serif}

/* ---------- essay ---------- */
.essay{
  font-size:1.03rem; line-height:1.95; background:
    repeating-linear-gradient(transparent, transparent 33px, var(--line) 33px, var(--line) 34px);
  background-attachment:local; padding:6px 4px; border-radius:10px;
}
body.no-marks .hl{background:transparent; padding:0}
.counter{font-weight:700; font-size:.88rem; color:var(--ink-soft)}
.counter b{color:var(--accent-ink)}
.portrait{
  width:260px; height:260px; border-radius:26px; border:3px solid var(--line); background:var(--lav);
  display:grid; place-items:center; overflow:hidden; float:right; margin:0 0 14px 18px; font-size:3.4rem;
}
.portrait img{width:100%; height:100%; object-fit:cover}
.legend{display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:7px; margin:14px 0 0}
.legend span{font-size:.74rem; font-weight:700; background:var(--lav); padding:4px 10px; border-radius:999px}

/* ---------- script / teleprompter ---------- */
.script p{max-width:60ch}
.cue{font-size:.76rem; font-weight:700; color:var(--ink-soft); margin:22px 0 4px}
.timer{font-family:"Fraunces",serif; font-size:2.3rem; font-weight:800; line-height:1}
.prompter{
  position:fixed; inset:0; z-index:100; background:var(--paper); display:none; flex-direction:column;
}
.prompter.open{display:flex}
.prompter-bar{display:flex; gap:10px; align-items:center; flex-wrap:wrap; padding:12px 16px; border-bottom:2px solid var(--line)}
.prompter-text{
  overflow-y:auto; padding:8vh 6vw 60vh; font-family:"Fraunces",serif; font-size:clamp(1.3rem,3.6vw,2.2rem);
  line-height:1.6; flex:1;
}
.prompter-text .hl{background:var(--butter)}

.memeslot{margin-top:12px; display:flex; gap:10px; align-items:center; flex-wrap:wrap}
.memeslot img{flex-basis:100%; width:100%; max-width:440px; border-radius:16px; border:2px solid var(--line); display:block}
.memeslot .hint{font-size:.8rem; color:var(--ink-soft)}
.qrbox{margin-top:16px; display:none; align-items:center; gap:16px; flex-wrap:wrap}
.qrbox.show{display:flex}
.qrbox canvas, .qrbox img{border:8px solid #fff; border-radius:14px; background:#fff}
.qrbox p{font-size:.85rem; color:var(--ink-soft); margin:0; max-width:34ch}

/* ---------- resources ---------- */
.res-grid{display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(280px,1fr)); gap:16px}
.res{border:2px solid var(--line); border-radius:20px; background:var(--card); padding:16px}
.res .tag{font-size:.72rem; font-weight:700; background:var(--sky); border-radius:999px; padding:3px 10px; display:inline-block; margin:0 6px 8px 0}
.res .tag.Game{background:var(--butter)} .res .tag.Practice{background:var(--mint)} .res .tag.Lesson{background:var(--lav)}
.res h3{font-size:1rem; margin:0 0 .3em}
.res h3 a{text-decoration:none}
.res h3 a:hover{text-decoration:underline}
.res p{font-size:.87rem; margin:0 0 .5em; color:var(--ink-soft)}
.res .use{font-size:.83rem; background:var(--mint); border-radius:10px; padding:7px 10px; margin:0}
:root[data-theme="dark"] .res .use{color:var(--ink)}
@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark){:root:not([data-theme="light"]) .res .use{color:var(--ink)}}

/* ---------- quiz ---------- */
.q{border:2px solid var(--line); border-radius:20px; background:var(--card); padding:18px; margin-bottom:14px}
.q h3{font-size:1rem}
.opts{display:grid; gap:8px; margin-top:10px}
.opts button{
  text-align:left; font:inherit; border:2px solid var(--line); background:var(--paper); color:var(--ink);
  border-radius:14px; padding:10px 14px; cursor:pointer;
}
.opts button:hover:not(:disabled){border-color:var(--accent)}
.opts button.right{background:var(--mint); border-color:var(--mint)}
.opts button.wrong{background:var(--rose); border-color:var(--rose)}
.opts button:disabled{cursor:default}
.why{margin:10px 0 0; font-size:.88rem; color:var(--ink-soft); display:none}
.why.show{display:block}
.score{position:sticky; bottom:14px; background:var(--accent); color:#fff; border-radius:999px; padding:10px 20px;
  font-weight:700; text-align:center; width:fit-content; margin:20px auto 0}
:root[data-theme="dark"] .score{color:#221D2E}
@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark){:root:not([data-theme="light"]) .score{color:#221D2E}}

.note{font-size:.85rem; color:var(--ink-soft); background:var(--butter); border-radius:14px; padding:10px 14px; max-width:68ch}
:root[data-theme="dark"] .note{color:var(--ink)}
@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark){:root:not([data-theme="light"]) .note{color:var(--ink)}}
.saved{font-size:.78rem; color:var(--ink-soft); margin-left:auto}
table{width:100%; border-collapse:collapse; font-size:.9rem}
.scroll-x{overflow-x:auto}
th,td{text-align:left; padding:9px 12px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
th{font-weight:700; color:var(--ink-soft); font-size:.8rem}
footer{text-align:center; color:var(--ink-soft); font-size:.83rem; padding:40px 20px}

@media print{
  header.top,.toolbar,.prompter,nav.tabs,.theme-btn{display:none !important}
  section.page{display:block !important; page-break-after:always}
  body{background:#fff}
  .card,.gcard,.res,.q{border-color:#ccc}
  details{display:block} .gbody{display:block !important}
}
@media (max-width:640px){
  .portrait{float:none; margin:0 auto 16px; display:grid}
  .topbar{flex-wrap:wrap}
  nav.tabs{width:100%; margin-left:0; order:3}
}
</style>
</head>
<body>

<header class="top">
  <div class="topbar">
    <div class="brand">Grammar Portfolio<small>Chapters 11–20</small></div>
    <nav class="tabs" id="tabs" aria-label="Portfolio sections">
      <button data-go="home" aria-current="page">Cover</button>
      <button data-go="guide">1 · Grammar Guide</button>
      <button data-go="story">2 · My Life Story</button>
      <button data-go="future">3 · Dear Future Me</button>
      <button data-go="dream">4 · My Dream World</button>
      <button data-go="res">5 · Resources</button>
      <button data-go="quiz">Practice</button>
    </nav>
    <button class="theme-btn" id="themeBtn" title="Switch light / dark">🌙</button>
  </div>
</header>

<div class="wrap">

<!-- ============ COVER ============ -->
<section class="page active" id="home">
  <div class="cover">
    <p class="eyebrow">English Grammar Portfolio · Chapters 11–20</p>
    <h1>Ten chapters,<br>one voice of my own.</h1>
    <p class="lead">A visual grammar guide, two personal narratives, a spoken reflection and a collection of resources — everything I learned from the passive voice to conditionals and wishes.</p>
    <p style="margin-top:22px">Presented by <span class="namefield" id="studentName">Vanessa Alexandra Grande Morales</span></p>
    <p style="font-size:.9rem;color:var(--ink-soft)">Course <span id="courseName" style="border-bottom:2px dashed var(--line);padding:0 6px">English II</span> · Teacher <span id="teacherName" style="border-bottom:2px dashed var(--line);padding:0 6px">Irania García</span></p>
    <div class="chips">
      <span class="chip">The Passive</span><span class="chip m">Noun Clauses</span>
      <span class="chip p">Adjective Clauses</span><span class="chip b">Gerunds &amp; Infinitives</span>
      <span class="chip s">Conjunctions</span><span class="chip r">Adverb Clauses</span>
      <span class="chip m">Reduced Clauses</span><span class="chip">Connectives</span>
      <span class="chip b">Conditionals &amp; Wishes</span>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="index-grid">
    <button class="index-card" data-go="guide"><span class="num">1</span><h3>Grammar Guide</h3></button>
    <button class="index-card" data-go="story"><span class="num">2</span><h3>My Life Story</h3></button>
    <button class="index-card" data-go="future"><span class="num">3</span><h3>Dear Future Me</h3></button>
    <button class="index-card" data-go="dream"><span class="num">4</span><h3>My Dream World</h3></button>
    <button class="index-card" data-go="res"><span class="num">5</span><h3>Resources</h3></button>
    <button class="index-card" data-go="quiz"><span class="num">★</span><h3>Practice Quiz</h3></button>
  </div>

</section>

<!-- ============ COMPONENT 1 ============ -->
<section class="page" id="guide">
  <p class="eyebrow">Component 1</p>
  <h2>My Grammar Guide</h2>
  <div class="toolbar">
    <button class="btn ghost" id="openAll">Open all chapters</button>
    <button class="btn ghost" id="closeAll">Close all</button>
    <button class="btn soft" id="marksBtn">Hide highlights</button>
  </div>

  <div class="guide-grid" id="guideGrid"></div>
</section>

<!-- ============ COMPONENT 2 ============ -->
<section class="page" id="story">
  <p class="eyebrow">Component 2</p>
  <h2>My Life Story</h2>
  <div class="card">
    <div class="toolbar" style="margin-bottom:14px">
      <button class="btn soft" id="marksBtn2">Hide highlights</button>
      <label class="btn ghost" style="cursor:pointer">Add my photo<input type="file" id="photoInput" accept="image/*" hidden></label>
      <span class="counter" id="wordCount">0 words</span>
    </div>

    <div class="portrait" id="portrait" title="Your self-portrait">🖼️</div>

    <div class="essay" contenteditable="true" id="essayText" spellcheck="true">
      <p>English was not my idea; it <span class="hl" title="Ch.11 Passive">was chosen</span> for me. <span class="hl" title="Ch.17 Adverb clause of time">When I was a girl</span>, I was not interested in the language at all. My mother, <span class="hl" title="Ch.13 Adjective clause, extra information">who never asked for my opinion</span>, enrolled me at CALUSAC, and I studied there for six years.</p>

      <p><span class="hl" title="Ch.14 Gerund as subject">Getting to class</span> was the hardest part of my journey. I travelled for hours by bus and arrived <span class="hl" title="Ch.16 Parallel structure">tired, hungry, and late</span>, week after week. <span class="hl" title="Ch.18 Reduced adverb clause">While riding home</span>, I repeated new words quietly <span class="hl" title="Ch.19 Connective of purpose: so that">so that nobody on the bus would hear me</span>. At home I practised alone in my room, talking to the mirror like a strange little actress.</p>

      <p>Little by little I understood <span class="hl" title="Ch.12 Noun clause">that my mother had been right</span>. <span class="hl" title="Ch.19 Connective: due to + noun phrase">Due to all those years of repetition</span>, I was finally able to hold real conversations with native speakers, and those conversations changed everything I believed about myself.</p>

      <p>Today I teach English to <i>básicos</i> students at Cornerstone International School, and I am still learning while I teach. <span class="hl" title="Ch.20 Wish about the past">I wish I had thanked my mother sooner.</span> <span class="hl" title="Ch.20 Real conditional">If I keep studying with the same stubbornness, I will graduate as a PEM in English</span> — and I cannot wait for that day. English stopped being an obligation; it became the thing I love most.</p>
    </div>

    <div class="legend">
      <span>11 Passive</span><span>12 Noun clause</span><span>13 Adjective clause</span><span>14 Gerund</span>
      <span>16 Parallel structure</span><span>17 Adverb clause</span><span>18 Reduced clause</span>
      <span>19 Connectives</span><span>20 Conditionals</span><span>20 Wish</span>
    </div>
  </div>

</section>

<!-- ============ COMPONENT 3 ============ -->
<section class="page" id="future">
  <p class="eyebrow">Component 3</p>
  <h2>Dear Future Me</h2>
  <div class="card">
    <div class="toolbar" style="margin-bottom:6px">
      <button class="btn" data-prompter="futureScript">Open teleprompter</button>
      <button class="btn ghost" data-timer="futureTimer">Start timer</button>
      <span class="timer" id="futureTimer">00:00</span>
    </div>
    <div class="scroll-x">
    <table>
      <tr><th>Structure</th><th>Where it appears</th></tr>
      <tr><td>Noun clauses</td><td>“I hope that…”, “what I want you to remember”, “whether…”</td></tr>
      <tr><td>Real conditionals</td><td>“If you are still…, then…”</td></tr>
      <tr><td>Unreal conditionals</td><td>“If I could send you one thing…”</td></tr>
      <tr><td>Past unreal</td><td>“If I had known…, I would have…”</td></tr>
      <tr><td>Wishes</td><td>“I wish I had…”, “I wish you would…”</td></tr>
    </table>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="card script" contenteditable="true" id="futureScript" spellcheck="true">
    <p class="cue">Intro · 0:00–0:40 · warm, unhurried</p>
    <p>Hello, future me. It is <span class="hl">September 16, 2026</span>, it is late, and I am recording this after a long day of teaching, because I want you to hear my real voice and not only read my handwriting. <span class="hl" title="Noun clause">I know that you have forgotten how this year actually felt</span>, so let me remind you.</p>

    <p class="cue">Where I am now · 0:40–1:40</p>
    <p>Right now I teach English to <i>básicos</i> students at Cornerstone International School, and I am still a student myself. It is strange: I stand in front of a class explaining the passive voice, and six years ago I was the girl on the bus to CALUSAC repeating words under her breath. <span class="hl" title="Noun clause">What nobody told me is that teaching would teach me more than studying ever did</span>.</p>

    <p class="cue">What I am working towards · 1:40–2:40</p>
    <p><span class="hl" title="Noun clause">I hope that you already have the TOEFL certificate</span> framed somewhere, because this year it is the thing I think about every night. <span class="hl" title="Real conditional">If I keep studying the way I am studying now, I will pass it</span>, and after that I want more experience, better training, and real professional connections — people who push me to be the best at what I do. <span class="hl" title="Wish about the present">I wish I were more confident already</span>, but confidence seems to arrive slowly, one class at a time.</p>

    <p class="cue">The people · 2:40–3:30</p>
    <p><span class="hl" title="Noun clause">I hope that you kept the friendships</span> that made this year lighter, and that you are still the kind of teacher who gives her students joy and affection in every single class, not just grammar. That matters more to me than any grade. <span class="hl" title="Unreal conditional, present">If I could choose only one thing to be remembered for, it would be that</span> my students felt safe in my classroom.</p>

    <p class="cue">The promises · 3:30–4:30</p>
    <p><span class="hl" title="Wish about the future">I wish you would not forget my mother.</span> She is the reason I speak English at all, and I promised myself two things: that I will have my own house one day, and that I will help her build her own <i>vivero</i> — a place full of plants, all hers, with her name on it. <span class="hl" title="Unreal conditional, past">If I had listened to her earlier, I would have started all of this sooner</span>, but I am not going to waste time on regret.</p>

    <p class="cue">Close · 4:30–5:00 · slower, quieter</p>
    <p>That is all, future me. <span class="hl" title="Unreal conditional">If I met you tomorrow, I think I would recognise you immediately</span> — same laugh, better accent, calmer hands. Take care of the person I am becoming. I will keep my part of the deal.</p>
  </div>

<!-- teleprompter -->
<div class="prompter" id="prompter" role="dialog" aria-label="Teleprompter">
  <div class="prompter-bar">
    <button class="btn" id="ppPlay">Play</button>
    <label style="font-size:.85rem;font-weight:700">Speed
      <input type="range" id="ppSpeed" min="10" max="120" value="45" style="vertical-align:middle">
    </label>
    <span class="timer" id="ppTimer" style="font-size:1.4rem">00:00</span>
    <button class="btn ghost" id="ppClose" style="margin-left:auto">Close</button>
  </div>
  <div class="prompter-text" id="ppText"></div>
</div>

<script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/qrious/4.0.2/qrious.min.js"></script>
<script>
/* ---------------- storage helpers ---------------- */
const store = {
  get(k){ try{ return localStorage.getItem('gp_'+k); }catch(e){ return null; } },
  set(k,v){ try{ localStorage.setItem('gp_'+k,v); return true; }catch(e){ return false; } },
  del(k){ try{ localStorage.removeItem('gp_'+k); }catch(e){} }
};

const MEMES = {
  11: "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
  12: "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
  13: "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
  14: "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
  15: "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
  16: "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
  17: "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
  18: "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
  19: "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
  20: "data:image/jpeg;base64,"
};
const PORTRAIT_DEFAULT = "data:image/jpeg;base64,";


/* ---------------- theme ---------------- */
const themeBtn = document.getElementById('themeBtn');
function applyTheme(t){
  if(t) document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-theme', t);
  else document.documentElement.removeAttribute('data-theme');
  themeBtn.textContent = (t === 'dark') ? '☀️' : '🌙';
}
applyTheme(store.get('theme'));
themeBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
  const cur = document.documentElement.getAttribute('data-theme');
  const isDark = cur ? cur === 'dark'
    : window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches;
  const next = isDark ? 'light' : 'dark';
  applyTheme(next); store.set('theme', next);
});

/* ---------------- navigation ---------------- */
function go(id){
  document.querySelectorAll('section.page').forEach(s => s.classList.toggle('active', s.id === id));
  document.querySelectorAll('#tabs button').forEach(b =>
    b.hasAttribute('data-go') && (b.getAttribute('data-go') === id
      ? b.setAttribute('aria-current','page') : b.removeAttribute('aria-current')));
  window.scrollTo({top:0, behavior:'instant'});
}
document.addEventListener('click', e => {
  const t = e.target.closest('[data-go]');
  if(t) go(t.getAttribute('data-go'));
});

/* ---------------- editable fields persist ---------------- */
const EDITABLE = ['essayText','futureScript','dreamScript'];
EDITABLE.forEach(id => {
  const el = document.getElementById(id);
  if(!el) return;
  const saved = store.get(id);
  if(saved !== null) el.innerHTML = saved;
  let t;
  el.addEventListener('input', () => {
    clearTimeout(t);
    t = setTimeout(() => {
      store.set(id, el.innerHTML);
      if(id === 'essayText') countWords();
    }, 400);
  });
});

/* ---------------- highlights toggle ---------------- */
function toggleMarks(){
  document.body.classList.toggle('no-marks');
  const off = document.body.classList.contains('no-marks');
  ['marksBtn','marksBtn2'].forEach(id => {
    const b = document.getElementById(id);
    if(b) b.textContent = off ? 'Show highlights' : 'Hide highlights';
  });
}
['marksBtn','marksBtn2'].forEach(id => document.getElementById(id)?.addEventListener('click', toggleMarks));

/* ---------------- word counter + portrait ---------------- */
function countWords(){
  const el = document.getElementById('essayText');
  const n = (el.innerText.trim().match(/\S+/g) || []).length;
  const box = document.getElementById('wordCount');
  const ok = n >= 200 && n <= 250;
  box.innerHTML = '<b>' + n + '</b> words';
}
countWords();

const portrait = document.getElementById('portrait');
const savedPhoto = store.get('portrait') || PORTRAIT_DEFAULT;
if(savedPhoto) portrait.innerHTML = '<img alt="Self-portrait" src="' + savedPhoto + '">';
document.getElementById('photoInput').addEventListener('change', e => {
  const f = e.target.files[0]; if(!f) return;
  const r = new FileReader();
  r.onload = () => {
    portrait.innerHTML = '<img alt="Self-portrait" src="' + r.result + '">';
    store.set('portrait', r.result);
  };
  r.readAsDataURL(f);
});

/* ---------------- timers ---------------- */
function mmss(s){ return String(Math.floor(s/60)).padStart(2,'0') + ':' + String(s%60).padStart(2,'0'); }
document.querySelectorAll('[data-timer]').forEach(btn => {
  const out = document.getElementById(btn.getAttribute('data-timer'));
  let id = null, s = 0;
  btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
    if(id){ clearInterval(id); id = null; btn.textContent = 'Resume timer'; return; }
    btn.textContent = 'Pause timer';
    id = setInterval(() => {
      s++; out.textContent = mmss(s);
      out.style.color = (s >= 180 && s <= 300) ? 'var(--accent-ink)' : '';
    }, 1000);
  });
  btn.addEventListener('dblclick', () => { clearInterval(id); id = null; s = 0; out.textContent = '00:00'; btn.textContent = 'Start timer'; });
});

/* ---------------- teleprompter ---------------- */
const pp = document.getElementById('prompter'), ppText = document.getElementById('ppText'),
      ppPlay = document.getElementById('ppPlay'), ppSpeed = document.getElementById('ppSpeed'),
      ppTimer = document.getElementById('ppTimer');
let ppRaf = null, ppOn = false, ppSec = 0, ppClock = null, ppPos = 0;
document.querySelectorAll('[data-prompter]').forEach(b => b.addEventListener('click', () => {
  ppText.innerHTML = document.getElementById(b.getAttribute('data-prompter')).innerHTML;
  ppText.scrollTop = 0; ppPos = 0; ppSec = 0; ppTimer.textContent = '00:00';
  pp.classList.add('open');
}));
function ppStop(){
  ppOn = false; ppPlay.textContent = 'Play';
  cancelAnimationFrame(ppRaf); clearInterval(ppClock);
}
ppPlay.addEventListener('click', () => {
  if(ppOn){ ppStop(); return; }
  ppOn = true; ppPlay.textContent = 'Pause';
  ppPos = ppText.scrollTop;
  let last = performance.now();
  ppClock = setInterval(() => { ppSec++; ppTimer.textContent = mmss(ppSec); }, 1000);
  const step = now => {
    if(!ppOn) return;
    const dt = (now - last) / 1000; last = now;
    ppPos += (Number(ppSpeed.value) * dt);
    ppText.scrollTop = ppPos;
    if(ppText.scrollTop + ppText.clientHeight >= ppText.scrollHeight - 2){ ppStop(); return; }
    ppRaf = requestAnimationFrame(step);
  };
  ppRaf = requestAnimationFrame(step);
});
document.getElementById('ppClose').addEventListener('click', () => { ppStop(); pp.classList.remove('open'); });
document.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
  if(!pp.classList.contains('open')) return;
  if(e.key === 'Escape'){ ppStop(); pp.classList.remove('open'); }
  if(e.key === ' '){ e.preventDefault(); ppPlay.click(); }
});


/* ---------------- Component 1 data ---------------- */
const CHAPTERS = [
 {n:11, t:'The Passive', icon:'🔄', color:'var(--lav)',
  ex:'The passive turns the object into the subject: <b>be + past participle</b>. I use it when the action matters more than the person doing it, when I do not know who did it, or when I do not want to say. The doer, if I mention it at all, hides at the end after <i>by</i>. <i>Get</i> can replace <i>be</i> in informal speech, and <i>-ed / -ing</i> adjectives come from the same family: the lesson was <i>boring</i>, so I was <i>bored</i>.',
  s:['My first English notebook <span class="hl">was bought</span> by my mother in 2015.',
     'All the homework <span class="hl">has been corrected</span>, so we can start the new unit.',
     'I <span class="hl">got confused</span> by the difference between <i>bored</i> and <i>boring</i>, and I was <span class="hl">interested</span> enough to look it up.'],
  meme:['🪟','“Who broke the window?” — “The window <i>was broken</i>.” The passive: protecting guilty people since 1066.']},

 {n:12, t:'Noun Clauses', icon:'💬', color:'var(--mint)',
  ex:'A noun clause is a whole clause doing the job of a single noun — subject, object or complement. It starts with <i>that</i>, <i>what</i>, <i>whether / if</i>, or a question word. The trap is word order: inside the clause it becomes a statement again, not a question. <i>Where is she?</i> → <i>I don\'t know where she is.</i>',
  s:['<span class="hl">That I passed the exam</span> surprised nobody except me.',
     'I believe <span class="hl">that English opens doors</span> I cannot even see yet.',
     'Nobody knows <span class="hl">whether the presentation will be online or in class</span>.'],
  meme:['🙃','Direct question: <i>Where is it?</i> Embedded: <i>Do you know where it is?</i> The verb sits down and behaves.']},

 {n:13, t:'Adjective Clauses', icon:'🔗', color:'var(--peach)',
  ex:'An adjective clause describes a noun, just like an adjective, but with a subject and a verb inside. It begins with <i>who, whom, which, that, whose, where, when</i> and sits right after the noun it describes. Commas change the meaning: with commas the information is extra, without them it identifies which one. It can also be reduced to a phrase: <i>the girl who is sitting there</i> → <i>the girl sitting there</i>.',
  s:['My mother, <span class="hl">who is a nurse</span>, taught me my first English words.',
     'The school <span class="hl">where I studied</span> only had one English teacher for 400 students.',
     'I still keep the dictionary <span class="hl">whose cover</span> my little brother destroyed.'],
  meme:['🏷️','The commas are the difference between “my sister who lives in Spain” (I have several sisters) and “my sister, who lives in Spain” (I have one).']},

 {n:14, t:'Gerunds & Infinitives · Part 1', icon:'🎬', color:'var(--butter)',
  ex:'When a verb becomes the object of another verb, it changes shape: <i>-ing</i> (gerund) or <i>to + verb</i> (infinitive). There is no rule you can reason out — the verb decides. <i>Enjoy, avoid, finish, keep, mind</i> take gerunds; <i>decide, hope, plan, want, need</i> take infinitives. Some verbs take an object first: <i>my teacher encouraged me to speak</i>.',
  s:['I enjoy <span class="hl">watching</span> series in English without subtitles.',
     'Last January I decided <span class="hl">to study</span> grammar for twenty minutes every night.',
     'My teacher encouraged <span class="hl">me to speak</span> even when my sentences were broken.'],
  meme:['💘','<i>enjoy</i> ❤️ -ing · <i>decide</i> ❤️ to + verb · <i>stop</i> 💔 “it\'s complicated”']},

 {n:15, t:'Gerunds & Infinitives · Part 2', icon:'✨', color:'var(--sky)',
  ex:'The advanced half. <i>In order to</i> expresses purpose. <i>Too</i> means more than enough to stop you; <i>enough</i> means sufficient. Gerunds and infinitives also have passive and past forms (<i>being chosen</i>, <i>to have finished</i>). Causatives <i>make / have / get</i> and verbs of perception follow their own patterns: <i>make someone do</i>, <i>get someone to do</i>, <i>I saw her running</i>.',
  s:['I moved to the capital <span class="hl">in order to improve</span> my English.',
     'I was <span class="hl">too shy to answer</span>, but now I am <span class="hl">confident enough to present</span> alone.',
     'My teacher <span class="hl">made me repeat</span> the sentence and <span class="hl">had me record</span> it three times.'],
  meme:['📏','<i>too tired to study</i> = I didn\'t study. <i>tired enough to sleep</i> = I slept. One word, opposite endings.']},

 {n:16, t:'Coordinating Conjunctions', icon:'⚖️', color:'var(--rose)',
  ex:'FANBOYS — <i>for, and, nor, but, or, yet, so</i> — join equal parts. Whatever goes on one side must match on the other: nouns with nouns, gerunds with gerunds, clauses with clauses. That is parallel structure. Use a comma before the conjunction when it joins two complete sentences, and with paired conjunctions (<i>both…and</i>, <i>not only…but also</i>, <i>either…or</i>, <i>neither…nor</i>) keep both halves the same shape.',
  s:['I like <span class="hl">reading, writing, and listening</span> to podcasts in English.',
     'I was exhausted, <span class="hl">but</span> I finished the assignment before midnight.',

  meme:['🚫','“Mary likes hiking, swimming, and <s>to ride a bike</s>.” The third one shows up in the wrong outfit.']},

 {n:17, t:'Adverb Clauses', icon:'⏱️', color:'var(--lav)',
  ex:'An adverb clause adds time, cause, contrast or condition to the main clause. It starts with a subordinating word — <i>when, after, because, since, even though, while, if, unless, in case, only if, whether or not</i> — and it cannot stand alone. When it comes first, put a comma after it; when it comes second, usually no comma.',
  s:['<span class="hl">When I was ten</span>, I heard my first song in English on the radio.',
     'My listening improved <span class="hl">because I practised every single morning</span>.',
     '<span class="hl">Even though I still make mistakes</span>, I keep speaking — and <span class="hl">unless I review tonight</span>, I will forget half of this.'],
  meme:['🧲','The adverb clause is a magnet with no fridge. Give it a main clause or it is a fragment.']},

 {n:18, t:'Reduction of Adverb Clauses', icon:'✂️', color:'var(--mint)',
  ex:'If the subject of the adverb clause is the same as the subject of the main clause, you can cut the subject and change the verb to <i>-ing</i>. <i>While I was studying</i> → <i>While studying</i>. Cause clauses drop the conjunction entirely: <i>Because I was tired</i> → <i>Being tired</i>. <i>Upon + -ing</i> means “immediately when”. If the subjects differ, reduction creates a dangling modifier — the classic mistake.',
  s:['<span class="hl">While studying</span> for the final test, I fell asleep on my notes.',
     '<span class="hl">After finishing</span> my homework, I called my best friend to complain about it.',
     '<span class="hl">Upon receiving</span> my grade, I read it four times to be sure.'],
  meme:['⚠️','“While walking to school, my backpack broke.” Congratulations — your backpack walks to school.']},

 {n:19, t:'Connectives: Cause, Contrast, Condition', icon:'🌉', color:'var(--peach)',
  ex:'Same ideas as chapter 17, different grammar and different punctuation. <i>Because of / due to</i> take a noun phrase. <i>Therefore, consequently, however, nevertheless, otherwise</i> are transitions between two independent clauses — semicolon before, comma after. <i>So that</i> expresses purpose, and <i>so… that / such… that</i> expresses result.',
  s:['<span class="hl">Due to</span> my work schedule, I study late at night.',
     'I was <span class="hl">so nervous that</span> I forgot my lines; <span class="hl">therefore</span>, I practised twice as much the next week.',
     'I have to review tonight; <span class="hl">otherwise</span>, I will forget everything by Friday.'],
  meme:['🧩','<i>because</i> + sentence · <i>because of</i> + noun · <i>therefore</i> + semicolon. Three keys, three different locks.']},

 {n:20, t:'Conditional Sentences & Wishes', icon:'🔮', color:'var(--butter)',
  ex:'Real condition: <i>if + present</i>, <i>will + verb</i>. Unreal present: <i>if + past</i>, <i>would + verb</i>. Unreal past: <i>if + past perfect</i>, <i>would have + participle</i>. Wishes take the same backward step: <i>I wish I knew</i> (now), <i>I wish I had known</i> (before), <i>I wish you would</i> (a complaint about the future). Nothing is really in the past — the tense just measures distance from reality.',
  s:['<span class="hl">If I have time tonight, I will record</span> my podcast episode.',
     '<span class="hl">If I studied every morning, I would feel</span> much more confident in class.',
     '<span class="hl">I wish I had started</span> learning English when I was five.'],
  meme:['🕰️','Unreal = take one step back in time. Present problem, past tense. Past regret, past perfect. The grammar time-travels so you don\'t have to.']}
];

/* video link + QR for components 3 and 4 */
['future','dream'].forEach(key => {
  const inp = document.getElementById(key + 'Link'),
        box = document.getElementById(key + 'QR'),
        open = document.getElementById(key + 'Open');
  if(!inp) return;
  const refresh = () => {
    const v = inp.value.trim();
    open.hidden = !v; open.href = v || '#';
  };
  const saved = store.get(key + 'Link');
  if(saved) inp.value = saved;
  refresh();
  inp.addEventListener('input', () => { store.set(key + 'Link', inp.value.trim()); refresh(); box.classList.remove('show'); });
  document.querySelector('[data-qr="' + key + '"]').addEventListener('click', () => {
    const v = inp.value.trim();
    if(!v){ inp.focus(); return; }
    box.innerHTML = '';
    if(typeof QRious === 'function'){
      const cv = document.createElement('canvas');
      box.appendChild(cv);
      new QRious({ element: cv, value: v, size: 190, background: '#ffffff', foreground: '#3F3355', level: 'M' });
      const p = document.createElement('p');
      p.textContent = 'Point a phone camera at this code to open the recording. Print this page and the code prints with it.';
      box.appendChild(p);
    } else {
      box.innerHTML = '<p>The QR generator did not load. Your link still works: <a href="' + v + '" target="_blank" rel="noopener">open the video</a>.</p>';
    }
    box.classList.add('show');
  });
});

RES.forEach((r,i) => { if(!r.k) r.k = (i % 2 === 0) ? 'Lesson' : 'Practice'; });
const resGrid = document.getElementById('resGrid'), resFilter = document.getElementById('resFilter'),
      resSearch = document.getElementById('resSearch'), resCount = document.getElementById('resCount');
[...new Set(RES.map(r => r.c))].forEach(c => {
  const o = document.createElement('option');
  o.value = c; o.textContent = 'Chapter ' + c + ' · ' + RES.find(r => r.c === c).t;
  resFilter.appendChild(o);
});
const resKind = document.getElementById('resKind');
function drawRes(){
  const f = resFilter.value, q = resSearch.value.trim().toLowerCase(), k = resKind.value;
  const list = RES.filter(r =>
    (!f || String(r.c) === f) &&
    (!k || r.k === k) &&
    (!q || (r.n + r.d + r.t + r.w).toLowerCase().includes(q)));
  resGrid.innerHTML = list.map(r => `
    <article class="res">
      <span class="tag">Ch. ${r.c} · ${r.t}</span><span class="tag ${r.k}">${r.k === 'Game' ? '🎮 Game' : r.k}</span>
      <h3><a href="${r.u}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">${r.n}</a></h3>
      <p>${r.d}</p>
      <p class="use"><b>Why it helps:</b> ${r.w}</p>
    </article>`).join('') || '<p>No resource matches that search. Try a chapter number or a topic word.</p>';
  resCount.textContent = list.length + ' of ' + RES.length + ' resources';
}
resFilter.addEventListener('change', drawRes);
resKind.addEventListener('change', drawRes);
resSearch.addEventListener('input', drawRes);
drawRes();

/* ---------------- Quiz ---------------- */
const QUIZ = [
 {q:'Which sentence is a correct passive?', o:['The window broke by the wind.','The window was broken by the wind.','The window is break by the wind.'], a:1,
  w:'Passive = <i>be</i> + past participle. <i>Broke</i> is the past simple; <i>broken</i> is the participle. (Ch. 11)'},
 {q:'Choose the correct noun clause.', o:['I don\'t know where is the library.','I don\'t know where the library is.','I don\'t know where does the library.'], a:1,
  w:'Inside a noun clause the word order goes back to statement order: subject before verb. (Ch. 12)'},
 {q:'Which sentence uses the adjective clause correctly?', o:['The book who I read was long.','The book which I read it was long.','The book that I read was long.'], a:2,
  w:'<i>Who</i> is for people, and you never repeat the object pronoun inside the clause. (Ch. 13)'},
 {q:'She avoided ___ to him after the argument.', o:['to talk','talking','talk'], a:1,
  w:'<i>Avoid</i> belongs to the gerund family, along with <i>enjoy, finish, mind, keep</i>. (Ch. 14)'},
 {q:'Which sentence means "I did not go"?', o:['I was too tired to go.','I was tired enough to go.','I was enough tired to go.'], a:0,
  w:'<i>Too</i> marks an excess that stops the action; <i>enough</i> marks sufficiency. (Ch. 15)'},
 {q:'Which sentence has correct parallel structure?', o:['She likes swimming, running, and to cycle.','She likes swimming, running, and cycling.','She likes to swim, running, and cycling.'], a:1,
  w:'Everything joined by <i>and</i> has to wear the same grammatical form. (Ch. 16)'},
 {q:'Which one is punctuated correctly?', o:['Because it was raining we stayed home.','Because it was raining, we stayed home.','We stayed home, because it was raining.'], a:1,
  w:'An adverb clause in front takes a comma after it; at the end it usually takes none. (Ch. 17)'},
 {q:'Reduce: "While I was walking home, I saw an accident."', o:['While walking home, I saw an accident.','While home walking, I saw an accident.','While I walking home, I saw an accident.'], a:0,
  w:'Same subject in both clauses, so delete the subject and use the <i>-ing</i> form. (Ch. 18)'},
 {q:'Choose the correct connective.', o:['Because of it was late, we left.','Due to the late hour, we left.','Due to it was late, we left.'], a:1,
  w:'<i>Because of</i> and <i>due to</i> are followed by a noun phrase, never by a full clause. (Ch. 19)'},
 {q:'"If I ___ more time, I would travel." (but I don\'t)', o:['have','had','would have'], a:1,
  w:'An unreal present condition takes the past form in the <i>if</i>-clause and <i>would</i> in the result. (Ch. 20)'}
];
const quizGrid = document.getElementById('quizGrid'), scoreBox = document.getElementById('scoreBox');
let score = 0, answered = 0;
function drawQuiz(){
  score = 0; answered = 0; scoreBox.textContent = '0 / 10 correct';
  quizGrid.innerHTML = QUIZ.map((q,i) => `
    <div class="q">
      <h3>${i+1}. ${q.q}</h3>
      <div class="opts" data-q="${i}">${q.o.map((o,j) => `<button data-o="${j}">${o}</button>`).join('')}</div>
      <p class="why" id="why${i}">${q.w}</p>
    </div>`).join('');
}
drawQuiz();
quizGrid.addEventListener('click', e => {
  const b = e.target.closest('.opts button'); if(!b) return;
  const box = b.parentElement, qi = Number(box.getAttribute('data-q'));
  if(box.dataset.done) return;
  box.dataset.done = '1';
  const right = QUIZ[qi].a;
  [...box.children].forEach((btn,j) => {
    btn.disabled = true;
    if(j === right) btn.classList.add('right');
    else if(btn === b) btn.classList.add('wrong');
  });
  if(Number(b.getAttribute('data-o')) === right) score++;
  answered++;
  document.getElementById('why'+qi).classList.add('show');
  scoreBox.textContent = score + ' / 10 correct' + (answered === 10 ? (score >= 8 ? ' — ready to submit' : ' — review those chapters') : '');
});
document.getElementById('resetQuiz').addEventListener('click', drawQuiz);
</script>
